program.name: Yoga Volume
program.subject: Yoga
program.blurb: Three long yoga practices: standing strength, balance, then floor poses and backbends.
program.about: A full yoga week in three practices. Each opens with sun salutations; then long standing sequences one day, balance poses the next, and seated poses and backbends the third, with a quiet rest to close. Three days rotate. Level II holds every pose longer and Level III brings harder poses.
